- **[Disruption with some GitHub services](../../../../../knowledge/GitHub/updates/2026/github-status-history-github-ecff77931aa1.md)** - github; `unknown` / `high`. Nov 19, 18:17 UTC Resolved - Between November 5, 2026, at 18:02 UTC and November 19, 2026, at 18:05 UTC, GitHub users experienced unexpected expiration of their web browser sessions despite continued activity, requiring them to login. An authentication change introduced an issue that caused web requests to bypass the session activity updates and cookie renewal that normally extend session lifetime. Affected sessions consequently expired when they reached their initial expiration time. We mitigated the incident by deploying a fix to ensure that continued web activity renews session expiration and browser cookies. We are adding monitoring to detect unexpected drops in session renewal activity, helping us catch similar issues sooner and reduce their impact on users. Nov 19, 18:05 UTC Update - The degradation has been mitigated. We are monitoring to ensure stability. Nov 19, 17:43 UTC Monitoring - Starting around 18:02 UTC on November 5, GitHub web sessions stopped being renewed based on recent activity, so users were signed out when their sessions expired due to inactivity. Dependent services, including Webhooks, Pages and Copilot code review, saw secondary impact. - **[Increased timeouts due to surge in anonymous users](../../../../../knowledge/GitHub/updates/2026/github-status-history-github-62865e66e8b1.md)** - github; `unknown` / `low`. Nov 9, 09:09 UTC Resolved - On November 9, 2026, GitHub.com experienced intermittent timeouts between approximately 05:10 and 08:15 UTC. Across that full window, 6.5% of recorded requests to github.com timed out, with a five-minute peak of 13.9% between 07:40 and 07:45 UTC. Release downloads were more affected: 38.5% of recorded requests timed out, peaking at 76% during that same five-minute interval. The two main error waves lasted about two hours and ten minutes in total, with recovery between them. The errors affected repository browsing and disrupted some CI workflows and Copilot code review jobs. Contrary to our earlier updates, follow-up analysis confirmed at least 6,236 authenticated requests that timed out, affecting activity feeds, access to uploaded attachments and repository archive downloads. Errors occurred during elevated traffic to our web infrastructure that handles unauthenticated requests. Impact was mitigated when traffic causing pressure on this system was alleviated. Our follow-up work focuses on improving capacity monitoring, traffic prioritization improvements, and automated protection against traffic spikes. Nov 9, 09:09 UTC Update - We are resolving this...
